sloka: मन्त्रिभिस्त्वं यथोद्दिष्टैश्चतुर्भिस्त्रिभिरेव वा ।कच्चित् समस्तैर्व्यस्तैश्च मन्त्र मन्त्रयसे मिथ: ॥ २.१००.७२॥
transliteration: mantribhistvaṁ yathoddiṣṭaiścaturbhistribhireva vā ।kaccit samastairvyastaiśca mantra mantrayase mitha: ॥ 2.100.72॥

translations.english: I trust, the Vedas you have studied are fruitful, the acts which you commenced are productive, your wife is fruitful (blessed with a son) and the scriptures you studied are useful.
